acceptedAnswer.text: To get a quote for accessible flooring installation in Daly City, the process typically starts with contacting a local general contractor like City Dweller, LLC. You'll schedule an initial consultation where a representative will visit your home to assess the areas needing flooring, discuss your specific accessibility needs, and review material options. They will measure the space, inspect the existing subfloor, and identify any required preparations. Following this visit, you will receive a detailed proposal outlining the recommended flooring materials, scope of work, project timeline, and a comprehensive cost estimate tailored to your Daly City residence.
